body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-04-30 (Q4FY25 concall transcript): "The overall guidance of 20%, 25% will be maintained here as well in the Infra segment." Metric: Infra segment revenue growth / margin. Target: +20-25% (FY25 INR 674 cr); margin ~6%. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: missed. Evidence: FY26 Infra revenue derived as 5,552.8 - Engineering 4,359 - Polymer ~507 = ~INR 687 cr vs FY25 674 cr = ~+2% (derived, single-source). Q1FY26 Infra was -39% YoY. Explanation given: 'depends on contract execution' (Jul-25, prompted)
